settings.title: Settings
settings.extraMoviesHelp: Additional Movies folders — e.g. a second hard drive once the primary one fills up. New uploads still always go to the folder above; these just get scanned and streamed alongside it.
settings.extraTvHelp: Additional TV Shows folders — same idea as Movies above: point at a second drive without moving anything already sorted into the folder above.
settings.tmdbPlaceholder: Paste your TMDB v3 API key or v4 Read Access Token

library.findTvHint: Scans the Movies folder for files that actually look like TV episodes (S01E02, 1x02, or a bare season+episode code like a scene-release '1018') and lets you move them into TV Shows.
library.cleanNamesHint: Proposes a clean, readable name for every file in Movies (using the confirmed poster match when there is one, otherwise the best guess from the filename) and lets you review/edit before renaming anything on disk.
library.cleanNamesTvHint: Proposes a clean '{{Show Name}} S{{season}}E{{episode}}' name for every episode in TV Shows (using the confirmed poster match for the show name when there is one) and lets you review/edit before renaming anything on disk.

firstrun.intro: Your home library is free and needs no Beebo account. Set it up in a few minutes, then connect your phone.
firstrun.folderError: Could not choose a folder. Please try again.
firstrun.errUsername: Pick a username of at least 3 letters/numbers.
firstrun.errPassword: Use a password of at least 6 characters.
firstrun.foldersTitle: Where are your movies and shows?
firstrun.foldersIntro: Point Beebo at the folders where your movies and TV shows already live. Nothing is copied or moved.
firstrun.moviesBlurb: Films, one file or one folder each.
firstrun.tvBlurb: A folder per show, with a folder per season inside.
firstrun.lookingFolders: Looking for folders you already have…

firstrun.foundFolders.one: We found a folder that looks right. Pick it to use it:
firstrun.foundFolders.other: We found some folders that look right. Pick one to use it:

firstrun.useFolderRetry: Could not use that folder. Please try again.

firstrun.tv.none: No TV episodes found in this folder yet.

firstrun.folder.spaceSaverDir.title: Phone folder backups
firstrun.folder.spaceSaverDir.detail: Files copied by Folders & cleanup on a phone.
firstrun.folder.privateVaultDir.title: Encrypted private folders
firstrun.folder.privateVaultDir.detail: Each family member sets their folder name, password and recovery options in the phone app.
firstrun.folder.inboxDir.title: Video inbox
firstrun.folder.inboxDir.detail: Drop videos here for Beebo to sort into Movies or TV Shows.
firstrun.folder.tmdbCacheDir.title: Library artwork
firstrun.privateNote: Private-folder passwords and recovery keys are created on each person's phone. They are separate from sign-in passwords.
firstrun.posters.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
firstrun.posters.on: Posters and info are on. Beebo will fill in pictures, cast and descriptions as it finds your titles.
firstrun.posters.why: Without this, your library shows plain file names. A free movie website called TMDB supplies the posters, cast and descriptions, and it only takes a few minutes to get your own key.
firstrun.posters.hostedBody: Nothing to set up. Posters and info will appear on their own.
firstrun.posters.step1Rest: , then click the link in the email TMDB sends you.
firstrun.posters.step2Rest: and choose Create, then Developer. Any short answers on the form are fine.
firstrun.posters.step3: Copy the long code called API Key and paste it below.
firstrun.posters.later: You can also do this later in Settings. Your key stays on this computer.
firstrun.accountDone: Sign-in created. This is what you’ll use on your phone.
firstrun.accountHelp: Pick a username and password. You’ll type these in the Beebo app on your phone. They stay on this computer.
firstrun.phoneHelp: Install the Beebo app on your phone and open it. Tap Scan QR code on the first screen and point it at the code below, or scan it with your phone’s camera. Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this computer. If your app has no scan button yet, update the app, or type the address by hand.
firstrun.multiNetwork: This computer is on more than one network. Your phone must be on the same one as the address in the code.
firstrun.doctorButton: Can’t connect? Fix it for me
firstrun.doctorLink: Phone can’t connect? Fix it for me
firstrun.olderApps: Older phone apps and browsers can use {address}.
firstrun.awayHelp: Away from home, scan the code with your phone’s camera — or open this address in your phone’s web browser — to watch from anywhere.
firstrun.notOnlineProblem: It isn’t online yet — see Settings › Your Beebo address.
firstrun.comesOnline: It comes online a few seconds after Beebo starts.
firstrun.awayRoute: Beebo tries a direct connection first. If that cannot connect, an enabled relay can carry the encrypted video. Keep this computer on and Beebo signed in. The phone test below confirms the route used.
firstrun.awaySignedIn: You’re signed in. Your permanent address appears here in a moment, and in Settings › Your Beebo address, where you can change it.
firstrun.awayNotSetUp: Not set up. Your library works at home without it. You can start this any time from Settings.
firstrun.awayWhy: Only needed to watch when you’re not on your home Wi-Fi: on holiday, at work, at a relative’s. It uses a free Beebo account (an email and a password), and there is a 30-day free trial of the away service. Skip it if you only watch at home.
firstrun.haveAccount: I already have a Beebo account
firstrun.testNote: Relay availability and a successful phone test are separate checks. Connect from another network to verify your route.
firstrun.testSkipped: You skipped this for now. You can run it anytime here or in Settings › Connection.
firstrun.testLastResult: Last result: {result}. You can change this anytime in Settings › Connection.
firstrun.testDone: Done. You can change this anytime in Settings › Connection.
doctor.intro: Beebo checks this computer, one thing at a time, and fixes what it can.
doctor.runFailed: Beebo could not run the checks. Restart Beebo and try again.
doctor.copied: Copied. Paste it into an email to support@beeboentertainment.com. It has no passwords, sign-in details or file names.
doctor.headlineGood: Everything looks good on this computer.

doctor.headlineWarnings.other: Nearly there. {count} things are worth a look.

doctor.fix.restart.label: Restart Beebo
doctor.fix.restart.explain: Closes and reopens Beebo, which takes about ten seconds. Anyone watching right now will be interrupted.
doctor.fix.firewall.label: Fix the firewall
doctor.fix.firewall.explain: Windows will show a permission prompt (a shield) because changing the firewall needs administrator approval. Beebo only replaces its own rule, for its own port. Nothing changes unless you approve.
doctor.fix.retryRouter.label: Ask the router again
doctor.fix.retryRouter.explain: Asks your router once more to open the connection Beebo needs. It can take up to fifteen seconds.
doctor.fix.updateAddress.label: Update my address now
doctor.fix.updateAddress.explain: Tells beebo.tv where your home is right now.
doctor.fix.sleepSettings.label: Open sleep settings
doctor.fix.sleepSettings.explain: Opens the Windows page where you choose when this computer sleeps.
doctor.fix.openSignin.label: Set up away-from-home
doctor.fix.openSignin.explain: Opens the sign-in for watching away from home. Your home library never needs it.

appearance.a11yHint: Reduce motion switches off animations and hover movement. Large text raises text size everywhere it is themed.
appearance.shelvesHint: Choose which shelves appear and their order. Use the arrow buttons, or Alt+Up / Alt+Down on a row. You can also drag.
appearance.navHint: Hide or reorder sidebar entries. Settings and Appearance always stay so you can get back. Hiding an item only tidies the menu; it never changes who may open a page.
